    // One interior edge flipped. The single-operator form of `FlipEdges`.
    FlipEdge(self: TriangleMesh3D, edge: UndirectedEdgeIndex): TriangleMesh3D
    {
        var topology = self.TopologyOf;
        return self.FlipEdges(topology, SingleEdgeMask(topology.EdgeCount, edge));
    }
